# -d prints a unified diff (paths in the headers, timestamps aside) and leaves
# the source untouched.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -d .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
stdout -count=1 '^--- \S+/ops\.go\t\S+ \S+ [+-][0-9]{4}$'
stdout -count=1 '^\+\+\+ \S+/ops\.go\t\S+ \S+ [+-][0-9]{4}$'
stdout -count=1 '^@@ -1,7 \+1,14 @@$'
stdout -count=1 '^\+//go:build goexperiment.simd$'
stdout -count=1 '^\+import "simd"$'
stdout -count=1 '^-	for i := range dst \{$'
stdout -count=1 '^\+		_v1.Add\(_v2\).StorePart\(dst\[_i:\]\)$'
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig
! exists ops_simd.go

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
